CustomField.description: Determines date for last day of month for last year. Takes into account leap years.
CustomField.formula: DATE( VALUE( Period_Year__c)-1, VALUE(Month_No__c), CASE(VALUE(Month_No__c), 2, IF( OR( MOD( VALUE( Period_Year__c)-1, 400 ) = 0, AND( MOD( VALUE( Period_Year__c)-1, 4 ) = 0, MOD( VALUE( Period_Year__c)-1, 100 ) != 0 ) ), 29, 28), 4, 30, 6, 30, 9, 30, 11, 30, 31) )
CustomField.label: LY Date
